findings.note: HB 215, the Voter List Integrity Act, is listed with Jasperse among six sponsors. The committee substitute text (https://www.legis.ga.gov/api/legislation/document/20252026/234334) bars the Secretary of State and local election officials from joining certain multistate voter list maintenance groups and allows joint compacts with other states for voter list data. Date is the House hopper entry.
